explanation: Fires on the comma, "and", or "but" that joins descriptive adjectives or parallel descriptive items ("well researched[,] independent and unbiased", "huge [and] costly", "poorly organized [but] information-rich", "soft [and] supple"), and relatedly on the copula/article opening a description or definition ("is essentially [a] projector", "GLFW[:] A binding", "stored procedures [are]").
